description: Witness conditions see original words and their own constructed omissions (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x(candidate)
%conditions matches(without-elision($x), rival)
%rule candidate X [+T]
%rule rival $y(X) [+T]
%conditions text($) = "x", phonemes($) = "x", tags($y) = X, initial($y), $ ≅ @(X T="")
